meta.title: Larch Street Library: your neighbourhood branch
meta.description: Books, quiet rooms and free classes, three streets from the park.

text.h1: A quiet room three streets from the park
text.lede: Borrow books, use a computer, or sit and read. Everything here is free with a library card.

list: Story time for small children on Tuesday mornings
Help with phones and laptops on Thursday
A reading group on the first Saturday
Homework help after school on weekdays
Free tax forms in the front hall
